posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Awsome things to point out about the KS:

1. Omnitron-V! Not our familiar I, not quite the hero X, but V. Too awesome.

2. Long lost Ra? He looks awesome! Even after becoming Horus Ra, his power was not enough to best Set and the Ennead. He is back and more ornate than ever.

3. AbZero has a brand new shiney white suite! Awesome FV logo and he is now fully embracing hero status.

4. Bunker got a suite upgrade, and it looks very similar to one found in the Freedom Tower deck in the card game. I'll bet theres other suites out there!

5. You can see Tachon wearing a back brace of sorts. Just better technology or has she sustained a big injury like the incap side of her TLT card game promo?

6. The video is hillarious. Between Adams harddrive and dip dive dodging Wrenches, and Paul cleaning the floor, it was fantastic and hillarious. Well done.

7. Unlocked characters. WHO COULD THEY BE!? We are gonna want them. All of them.

No backing for me, I'm afraid. International shipping just kills it.

fromthe comments 

Creator GreaterThanGames about 1 hour ago

@Brett

So, each of the pledge levels include the cost of the game plus shipping. At the point that we hit funding, everyone gets art prints and promo cards for all of the characters. Then, at each Stretch Goal, there are additional free characters that will NOT be free outside the Kickstarter. These promo cards and additional characters are the sorts of things that people hound us for at conventions as via e-mail.

If you don't feel right supporting this Kickstarter, we totally understand, but Greater Than Games Kickstarters have always been focused on making sure our backers get significant bang for their buck. And that focus is still important to us.
